notes:
Summary: CodeBridge Systems is building an in-IDE copiloting layer used by their internal engineering teams and customer-facing SDKs. Primary concern is reproducible code completion behavior across releases; want model/version pinning, canaries and deterministic eval gates for PR-level regressions.

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2026-02-20: Intro call with AE (Aisha) + CTO (Marco Ruiz). Marco: "We must be able to pin a model for a released CLI tool and reproduce completions from a given commit."
- 2026-02-27: Deep-dive with SE (Liam) on latency envelope; ran initial perf questionnaire. Target: token-stream latency <50ms median for single-line completions, 99th <120ms for IDE interactions.
- 2026-03-03: Sent security packet and requested SOC2 + ISO artifacts. Legal asked about data residency and key management.
- 2026-03-07: Technical discovery call covering rollout strategies: canary by user cohort, model pin + auto-fallback to smaller quantized model on timeout, hooks for eval gate with unit-test style prompt set. Action: SE to propose POC plan.
- 2026-03-10: Pricing/deployment discussion; customer prefers Dedicated with VPC and optional on-prem replicant for regulated customers.

Requirements / Notes (shorthand):
- Use-case: IDE copilot + public SDK completions for paying customers.
- Must support model pinning at release-commit granularity and immutable model artifacts for audits.
- Need eval gates that run a deterministic prompt-suite (unit-test prompts) on every model rollout; failures should block canary promotion.
- Canary rollout: start with 1% internal engineers, expand to 10% beta users, then prod. Need automatic rollback on quality regression.
- Latency SLOs: median token <50ms, p95 <90ms on dedicated pool. Throughput: 6k concurrent sessions across org.
- Cost sensitivity: mid; willing to pay for dedicated capacity if unit economics clear.
- Security: SSO (SAML), KMS integration for model keys, audit logs retention 2 years, data residency for EU customers.

POC proposal (from SE):
- 2-week canary POC: deploy a pinned model variant (quantized and FP) in Dedicated pool; run scripted eval gates daily against baseline prompts in CI; measure token latency and code-correctness deltas.
- Instrument per-request tracing + token cost breakdown; provide dashboard slices by model variant and rollout cohort.

Quotes / call highlights:
- Marco (CTO): "If we can't reproduce a code suggestion from a given release, we can't ship the feature. Need immutable model identifiers and simple rollback."
- Head of Eng (Nina): "We like automatic fallback to cheaper quantized models when latency spikes, but only if eval gates guarantee no correctness regressions."

Open items / blockers:
- Legal approval pending for data residency clause in contract.
- Need explicit SLA language for canary failover and rollback windows.
- Want a concrete example of eval-gate failure handling (e.g., threshold rules, alerting, and automatic rollback).

Next steps (short):
- SE (Liam) to deliver POC plan + benchmark script by 2026-03-14.
- Schedule kickoff for canary POC week of 2026-03-17.
- Legal to review draft contract with residency clause (Aisha to coordinate).
